new_scholarship.description: The VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship is a partial fee-based scholarship of NZ$10,000 towards tuition fees for new international students entering a Master's degree programme of 120, 180 or 240 points, or a 120-point Postgraduate Diploma, at Te Herenga Waka — Victoria University of Wellington. programme_detail_official.description: The VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship provides NZ$10,000 towards tuition fees for new international students entering a Master's degree programme of 120, 180 or 240 points or a 120-point Postgraduate Diploma at Te Herenga Waka — Victoria University of Wellington, studying full-time on campus and paying full international fees. No separate scholarship application is required: eligibility is assessed when the applicant applies for their programme and the outcome is communicated in the Offer of Place.
